summary: A small task from a blank file that mixes the week: the knowledge base loader, embeddings and cosine similarity. You rank documents for two questions, then see the best match change when you add the missing documents and when you change which text you embed.
goal: Embed documents once and rank them for a question by cosine similarity, from a blank file.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then read the contract
Step 1: write three tests for cosine and see 3 passed
Step 2: write rank_docs.py for the first 10 documents and match the output
Step 3: move the embedding of the documents into the loop and think about 10,000 documents
Step 4: use all 20 documents, then embed the body only, and write what changed and why
Play the Ranking Referee game to the end and see your score
